name: arkho-templates
description: ARKHO CLI template catalog. Each entry mirrors the template's arkho.template.yaml; `version` is the latest published git tag (<name>@<version>).

items.name: react-spa
items.description: React SPA (TypeScript, Vite) wired to Cognito auth and a backend API, with atomic-design structure, shadcn/Radix UI, React Query, Axios, Zustand, and Zod.

items.name: aws-datalake-foundation
items.description: Foundational AWS Data Lake on CDK v2: 5 S3 zones (Raw/Clean/Curated Iceberg/Archive/Quarantine), Glue ETL with a data-quality gate and automatic Iceberg maintenance, Step Functions, enforced Lake Formation FGAC with an analyst role, KMS, Object Lock, multi-region CloudTrail with alarms, optional VPC + ingestion Lambdas. Four environments (dev/qa/stg/prod) in one shared AWS account or one account each, governed resource tagging, and CI for the generated project.
